source_contract.residual_component: C is a connected component of final residual G[Y0].
source_contract.base_lists: B_C(u)=[4]\f(N(u) intersect X0). Residual Y0 is anticomplete to the current seed, so seed colors remove nothing further from C.
source_contract.uniformity: Axiom (iv): no vertex outside Y0 union X0 is mixed on an edge of Y0. Since C is connected, every such outside vertex is complete or anticomplete to C.
source_contract.D_C: dynamic outside vertices complete to C
source_contract.F_C: for an outside coloring c, F_C(c)={c(v):v in D_C}
source_contract.exact_message: mu_C(F)=1 iff G[C] is list-colorable with L_F(u)=B_C(u)\F.

core_observation: Every reachable F_C(c) is nonempty when D_C != empty.
For every nonempty F, the union of all lists L_F(u) is contained in [4]\F and therefore uses at most three colors.
G[C] is an induced subgraph of the ambient P7-free graph and hence P7-free.
Therefore each nonempty mu_C(F) is decidable constructively by the known polynomial P7-free List-3-Coloring algorithm after relabeling the at-most-three remaining colors.

compilation_target.calls_per_component: at most 15 List-3 calls, one for each nonempty F subseteq [4]
compilation_target.witnesses: store one explicit component coloring for every nonempty F with mu_C(F)=1
compilation_target.monotonicity: If F subseteq F' and mu_C(F')=1 then mu_C(F)=1.
compilation_target.surviving_branch_full_table: If any nonempty F has mu_C(F)=1 then monotonicity gives mu_C(empty)=1, so all 16 entries are known.
compilation_target.all_nonempty_bad: If mu_C(F)=0 for every nonempty F and D_C!=empty, no outside coloring can extend through C; return exact branch UNSAT without querying mu_C(empty).

finite_language_targets.representation: The bad masks form an upset; inclusion-minimal bad masks MIN_BAD(C) form an antichain.
finite_language_targets.semantic_constraint: For each M in MIN_BAD(C), an outside coloring must satisfy M not subseteq F_C(c), equivalently at least one color in M is absent from the colors used on D_C.

firewalls: No claim about uncoupled components D_C=empty.
No P7-free List-4 call is imported.
Finite message alphabet does not imply tractable composition of many messages.
No claim that all 168 monotone functions are source-realizable.
